name: Appenzell Ausserrhoden
flagName: Flag of the Canton of Appenzell Ausserrhoden
summary: A white square with a black bear standing upright and the letters 'V R' for 'Usser Rhoden'. Appenzell split into two half-cantons along religious lines in 1597.
origin: Appenzell joined the Confederacy in 1513. In 1597 the Protestant Outer Rhodes separated from the Catholic Inner Rhodes. The letters distinguish the two otherwise similar bear flags.

symbols.name: Bear
symbols.description: A black bear standing on its hind legs.
symbols.meaning: From the arms of the Abbey of St Gall.

symbols.name: V R
symbols.description: Letters on either side of the bear.

facts: It was one of the last places in Europe to grant women the vote, in 1989.
Its bear comes from the abbey of St Gall.
clues: A black upright bear with the letters V and R on white.
It split from its twin along religious lines in 1597.
